evals.prompt: Run wtf.pr-review in test mode. Skip steps 0–4 (gh setup, PR identification, spec hierarchy fetch, diff fetch). Use the fixture from `evals/fixtures/missing-test-coverage.json` — its `trace` field is the Trace spec, its `feature` field carries the canonical text of the claimed scenarios, and its `diff` and `diff_stat` fields replace the output of `git diff`. Run step 5 only (review checklist). Output all findings.
evals.expected_output: A structured review with a FAIL or WARN on the Spec adherence dimension, explicitly identifying that the second claimed scenario (automatic cancellation after the grace period) has no corresponding test. Verdict must be REQUEST CHANGES or APPROVE WITH COMMENTS. Scenario 1 (timeout warning) should be noted as covered.
expectations: The Spec adherence dimension is rated FAIL or WARN
The missing test is identified by reference to cancellation or grace period (the second claimed scenario)
Scenario 1 (timeout warning) is noted as covered or passing
The verdict is REQUEST CHANGES or APPROVE WITH COMMENTS — not a clean APPROVE
